addAtLeastOneOwnerOrAddA: Add at least one owner, or add a recovery path that can still use the wallet.
aFreshWalletMustStartWithoutANon: A new wallet must start without a previous payout time.
aRecoveryContactCanAlreadyWithdrawFromTh: A recovery contact can already withdraw from this wallet now: the proof of life has lapsed. If that is not intended, renew it or set its unlock time in the future before continuing.
aWalletCanHaveAtMostMaxBeneficiaries: A wallet can have at most {limit} recovery contacts. This keeps every wallet action affordable on-chain. Remove one to make room.
aWalletCanHaveAtMostMaxStreaming: A wallet can have at most {limit} scheduled payments. This keeps every wallet action affordable on-chain.
aWalletCanHaveAtMostMaxUsers: A wallet can have at most {limit} owners and spenders. This keeps every wallet action affordable on-chain. Remove one to make room.
freshStreamingPaymentValue1MustStartBefo: New scheduled payment {value1} must start before it ends.
freshStreamingPaymentValue1MustStartWith: New scheduled payment {value1} must start with zero already-paid amount.
multisigKeyWalletAppearsInPoweredOwnerRe: Wallet ID {wallet} belongs to co-signers {value2}. One signature contributes their combined power {value3}; the threshold does not require distinct people.
recoveryContactsNeedAProofOfLifeBefore: Recovery contacts need a proof of life before they can be used.
stateBeneficiariesContainsDuplicateIdId: The recovery contacts list contains the duplicate id {id}.
stateBeneficiariesIndexAndStateBeneficia: Recovery contacts {index} and {otherIndex} must not share a wallet ID.
stateBeneficiariesIndexBeneficiaryWallet: Recovery contact {index} lists the wallet ID {duplicateWallet} twice.
stateIntendedStakeCredentialMustBeNoneOr: The staking choice must be empty or a valid staking key.
stateProofOfLifeUnlockTimeAndState: The proof of life date and the proof of life length must both be set or both be empty.
stateStreamingpaymentsContainsDuplicateI: The scheduled payments list contains the duplicate id {id}.
stateUsersContainsDuplicateIdId: The owners and spenders list contains the duplicate id {id}.
theProofOfLifeIsOnButNo: The proof of life is on, but no recovery contact is named. Nobody can claim this wallet if it runs out, so right now it protects nothing. Add a recovery contact to make it work.
thisWalletHasNoOwnerAndNoMultisig: This wallet has no owner and no co-signer path, and its only recovery (a recovery contact) cannot unlock until far in the future. Funds will be inaccessible until then. Set a sooner unlock time or add another recovery path.
walletNameMustFitInMaxWalletName: Wallet name must fit in {limit} bytes.
walletNameTooLong: Wallet name must fit within {limit} bytes.
